One. You hear a shop assistant.
We usually close at six, but today we close at four for repairs. Please finish shopping before four.

Two. You hear a girl.
I am wearing my brother’s old jacket. It still looks good, and sharing means I do not need to buy another one.

Three. You hear a school announcement.
Please return all costumes on Friday. You can keep the caps until Monday, but we need the costumes before the weekend.

Four. You hear a boy leaving a message.
Hi Tom. I left my glasses at your house. Can you bring them to school tomorrow? I need them for reading.

Five. You hear a teacher.
Your raincoats are wet. Leave them by the door to dry. Please do not put them into your bags yet.
